records.jp: この辺りまで来ると、人もいないし<CR>結構静かだよね
records.en_original: It sure is quiet. I guess not many people come out all the way here.
records.en: It sure is quiet. I guess not many people come out all the way here.

records.jp: うん。<CR>きららは、静かな場所が好き
records.en_original: Indeed. I prefer the quiet.
records.en: Yeah. Kirara likes quiet places.

records.jp: 石灯籠といえばさー<CR>こんな怖い話があるんだけど……
records.en_original: These stone lanterns kinda remind me of a spooky story I know...
records.en: These stone lanterns kinda remind me of a spooky story I know...

records.jp: ……ということで、その石灯籠を壊したせいで<CR>男は右腕を失うことになっちゃったんだって
records.en_original: ...And as punishment for breaking the lantern, he lost his right arm forever!
records.en: ...And as punishment for breaking the lantern, he lost his right arm forever!

records.jp: 因果応報というやつだな
records.en_original: Divine retribution, was it?
records.en: Divine retribution, was it?

records.jp: 古い物には魂が宿るって言うし、<CR>この石灯籠も大事にしないとだよねー
records.en_original: They say that souls rest in old things, after all. Gotta make sure we take care of these stone lanterns!
records.en: They say that souls rest in old things, after all. Gotta make sure we take care of these stone lanterns!

records.jp: 石灯籠か……<CR>そういえば、きららも……
records.en_original: Yes... That reminds me of something as well.
records.en: A stone lantern... Come to think of it, Kirara also...

records.jp: おや、もしかしてきららさんも<CR>石灯籠にまつわる怖い話をお持ちですかな？
records.en_original: Oho? Do you have a scary story about stone lanterns too, Kirara?
records.en: Oho? Do you have a scary story about stone lanterns too, Kirara-san?

records.jp: ううん。<CR>怖い話じゃないけど……いい？
records.en_original: Not quite. May I still tell you about it?
records.en: Not quite. May I still tell you about it?

records.jp: うん、もちろんいいよ
records.en_original: Of course!
records.en: Of course!

records.jp: きららの話、いろいろ聞いてみたいし
records.en_original: I'm always interested in what you have to say, Kirara.
records.en: I'm always interested in what you have to say, Kirara.

records.jp: そう言われると……なんかプレッシャー。<CR>やっぱり、やめる
records.en_original: That...is a lot of pressure. I've changed my mind.
records.en: That...is a lot of pressure. I've changed my mind.

records.jp: ええ！？　やめないで！
records.en_original: Wait, no don't!
records.en: Wait, no don't!

records.jp: ふむ……そこまで言うなら、仕方ない。<CR>聞かせてしんぜよう
records.en_original: Hmph... Very well. If you are so desperate to hear, let me regale you.
records.en: Hmph... Very well. If you are so desperate to hear, let me regale you.

records.jp: ありがたき幸せ！
records.en_original: Thank you, oh great one!
records.en: Thank you, oh great one!

records.jp: 怖い話が良かったなあ……
records.en_original: Aw... I wanted to hear a scary story.
records.en: Aw... I wanted to hear a scary story.

records.jp: 次回までには、ストックしておく。<CR>……５本ぐらい
records.en_original: I'll make sure I have plenty for next time then. Is five enough?
records.en: I'll make sure I have plenty for next time then. Is five enough?

records.jp: さすがです、きらら様
records.en_original: More than enough! That's my Kirara!
records.en: More than enough! That's my Kirara-sama!

records.jp: どやあ
records.en_original: Heh.
records.en: Heh.

records.jp: それで、きららの石灯籠の話って？
records.en_original: So what's the story about?
records.en: So what's the story about?

records.jp: ん～……きらら、子どもの頃は<CR>石灯籠の明かりを見るのが好きだったなって
records.en_original: Let's see here... When I was a little girl, I loved watching the lanterns glow in the night.
records.en: Hmm... When Kirara was a child, she liked watching the light of stone lanterns.

records.jp: へー。<CR>家の近くに灯籠があったとか？
records.en_original: You had some near your house?
records.en: You had some near your house?

records.jp: ん、そんな感じ。お祭りごとがあると<CR>石灯籠に灯りがついてた
records.en_original: Something like that. They would always be lit during special events like festivals.
records.en: Something like that. They would always be lit during special events like festivals.

records.jp: ゆっくりと瞬くみたいに揺れる<CR>ろうそくの灯りが、綺麗だったのだ
records.en_original: The flickering glow of the candles were beautiful.
records.en: The flickering glow of the candles were beautiful.

records.jp: 私、石灯籠ってあんまりなじみが<CR>なかったんだけど、実際に見ると……
records.en_original: I never really got the chance to see many stone lanterns growing up, but now that I've seen them up close...
records.en: I never really got the chance to see many stone lanterns growing up, but now that I've seen them up close...

records.jp: そんなに怖くないよね
records.en_original: They're not scary at all, are they?
records.en: They're not scary at all, are they?

records.jp: 愛央は、怖い話に影響されすぎだ
records.en_original: I think you put too much stock into that story, Ao.
records.en: I think you put too much stock into that story, Ao.

records.jp: 石灯籠の役目は、道を照らすこと。<CR>怪談とは関係ない
records.en_original: Lanterns are meant to guide travelers on dark roads. They're not supposed to be scary.
records.en: Lanterns are meant to guide travelers on dark roads. They're not supposed to be scary.

records.jp: あはは、やっぱり？
records.en_original: Ahaha, I guess that makes sense.
records.en: Ahaha, I guess that makes sense.

records.jp: 石灯籠のこの穴から、オバケが出てくる話とかも<CR>あるんだけどさ、結構小さいんだねー
records.en_original: There are stories about ghosts and stuff coming out through this hole, but its pretty teensy, huh?
records.en: There are stories about ghosts and stuff coming out through this hole, but its pretty teensy, huh?

records.jp: 穴……火口のことか
records.en_original: Hole? Ah, the fire box?
records.en: Hole? Ah, the fire box?

records.jp: へぇ！<CR>この穴、火口っていうんだ
records.en_original: Is that what it's called? You learn something new every day!
records.en: Is that what it's called? You learn something new every day!

records.jp: 面白いデザインだよね。<CR>なんか、すっごく和って感じだし！
records.en_original: They really have a cool design, don't they? They're like, quintessentially Japanese!
records.en: They really have a cool design, don't they? They're like, quintessentially Japanese!

records.jp: うん。この灯籠は、受花と格狭間の装飾が<CR>細かくてよくできている
records.en_original: Quite. Not only that, if you look closely, you can see the intricate designs on the upper support and in between the gaps.
records.en: Quite. Not only that, if you look closely, you can see the intricate designs on the upper support and in between the gaps.

records.en_original: ...What?
records.en: ...What?

records.jp: 笠の広がりも上品で、火袋の造りにも<CR>力強さを感じる
records.en_original: The way the roof curves out gives it quite a sophisticated feeling. The fire box also has a certain appeal to it.
records.en: The way the roof curves out gives it quite a sophisticated feeling. The fire box also has a certain appeal to it.

records.jp: ちょ、待って！　そこまで、本格的に<CR>デザインについては分析してない！
records.en_original: Just a sec, Kirara! I didn't expect a full breakdown of its artistic worth!
records.en: Just a sec, Kirara! I didn't expect a full breakdown of its artistic worth!

records.jp: そうなのか？
records.en_original: You didn't?
records.en: You didn't?

records.jp: そうなの！　てか、きらら。<CR>石灯籠についても詳しいとか何者……
records.en_original: Of course not! But, I didn't realize you were so clued in on lanterns, Kirara.
records.en: Of course not! But, I didn't realize you were so clued in on lanterns, Kirara.

records.jp: 普通に生活していたら得られる知識では
records.en_original: It's simple common knowledge, isn't it?
records.en: It's simple common knowledge, isn't it?

records.jp: いや、無理でしょ！　火袋だけは<CR>なんとなーく、聞いたことあったけど
records.en_original: No way! I mean, I think I'd heard of fire box before...
records.en: No way! I mean, I think I'd heard of fire box before...

records.jp: ……確か、この火を灯すところを<CR>火袋って言うんだよね
records.en_original: It's the place where the candle goes, right?
records.en: It's the place where the candle goes, right?

records.jp: うん。ここが火袋。で、この穴が火口。
records.en_original: Indeed. And the window allows you to access it.
records.en: Indeed. And the window allows you to access it.

records.jp: あ……火口で怖い話を思い出した
records.en_original: Ah! Windows reminded me of another scary story.
records.en: Ah! Windows reminded me of another scary story.

records.jp: え、なになに？
records.en_original: Ooh! I'm all ears!
records.en: Ooh! I'm all ears!

records.jp: 子供の頃、石灯籠の火口に腕を入れたら<CR>抜けなくなったことがあった
records.en_original: When I was but a girl, I put my arm inside the window of a lantern...and it got stuck.
records.en: When I was but a girl, I put my arm inside the window of a lantern...and it got stuck.

records.jp: あー、なんか子供がやりそうな悪戯だね
records.en_original: Oops. I can imagine most kids would try that at least once.
records.en: Oops. I can imagine most kids would try that at least once.

records.jp: どんなに引っ張っても抜けなくて……<CR>気が付けば、辺りはとっぷりと日が暮れて……
records.en_original: No matter how hard I pulled, it just wouldn't come loose. Soon enough, night started to fall...
records.en: No matter how hard I pulled, it just wouldn't come loose. Soon enough, night started to fall...

records.jp: えっ、そんなに！？
records.en_original: You were stuck for that long?!
records.en: You were stuck for that long?!

records.jp: 最終的に、大人たちが、チェンソーとか、<CR>ドリルとか持って来て……
records.en_original: Eventually, some of the adults had to free me with hammers and a drill.
records.en: Eventually, some of the adults had to free me with hammers and a drill.

records.jp: うっわ……想像したら、ゾッとした。<CR>それは、ガチで怖い……
records.en_original: Whoa, that IS scary...
records.en: Whoa, that IS scary...

records.jp: うん。<CR>今思い出しても、あれは怖かった
records.en_original: Yes. Even the memory is still rather unsettling.
records.en: Yes. Even the memory is still rather unsettling.

records.jp: それでよく石灯籠が好きって言えたね
records.en_original: But you said you liked stone lanterns though, right? Even after all that?
records.en: But you said you liked stone lanterns though, right? Even after all that?

records.jp: 石灯籠に罪はない。<CR>悪いのは、腕を突っ込んでしまったきらら
records.en_original: The lantern did nothing wrong. I was the one who stuck my arm in.
records.en: The stone lantern did nothing wrong. Kirara was the one who stuck her arm inside.

records.jp: でも、今でも石灯籠をみると<CR>不思議と、あの穴に腕を入れたく……
records.en_original: Although, saying that, for some reason my arm feels drawn to that lantern's window...
records.en: Although, saying that, for some reason my arm feels drawn to that lantern's window...

records.jp: わー！　ダメダメ！！
records.en_original: Whoa, hold it, Kirara!
records.en: Whoa, hold it, Kirara!

records.jp: 穴があったら入れたくなる心理とは、<CR>まさにこのことか
records.en_original: I suppose what they say is true, people are inexplicably drawn to stick their arms into any welcoming opening.
records.en: I suppose what they say is true, people are inexplicably drawn to stick their arms into any welcoming opening.

records.jp: いや、絶対に違う！<CR>てか、なんの話！？
records.en_original: Wait, no, who says that?!
records.en: Wait, no, who says that?!

records.jp: いやー、私だったらトラウマになるかも。<CR>チェンソーは、やばいって。チェンソーは
records.en_original: Whew, if it was me, I'd be super traumatized. What if they had to use a chain saw to remove my arm?
records.en: Whew, if it was me, I'd be super traumatized. What if they had to use a chain saw to remove my arm?

records.jp: うむ、チェンソーはやばい。<CR>……ん？　チェンソー……？
records.en_original: Quite, a chainsaw would certainly hurt... Wait... Saw...? Saw...?
records.en: Quite, a chainsaw would certainly hurt... Wait... Saw...? Saw...?

records.jp: どうしたの？
records.en_original: Is something the matter?
records.en: Is something the matter?

records.jp: 今、唐突にあれが食べたくなった
records.en_original: All of a sudden I'm really hungry.
records.en: All of a sudden I'm really hungry.

records.jp: ピリッと辛いソーセージ
records.en_original: I want some super spicy sausages.
records.en: I want some super spicy sausages.

records.jp: ……もしかして、チョリソー？
records.en_original: Why? Oh, wait... Saw...sage? Sausage? Is THAT why?
records.en: Why? Oh, wait... Saw...sage? Sausage? Is THAT why?

records.jp: おお、それだ！
records.en_original: Exactly!
records.en: Exactly!

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
